answer: Gate peer attestations on counterparty history: a key may only attest peers it transacted with in an earlier epoch, tracked in a per-key garden of distinct counterparties, and each new key adds just one counterparty per epoch. A sybil farm pushing a whole karst of aliases must grow every single one a real, paid trading history before its votes count - weeks of fees and work per alias - while each epoch folds every key's graph into one horizon Merkle root, so clone rings surface as duplicated subtrees whose attestation weight is zeroed.
